title: CGAP Dead Cell Removal Using EasySep Kit and Magnet
author: Adam Hunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qz6dx9e

steps.title: Assess cell number and viability
steps.instruction: Determine cell count and viability using a 1:1 trypan blue dilution; proceed with dead‑cell removal if viability is below 70‑80 %.

steps.title: Prepare recommended medium
steps.instruction: Mix 8 mL PBS, 160 µL FBS (2 % final), and 1 µL 1 M CaCl₂ (1 mM final) to make 8 mL of recommended medium.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Spin the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend cells to target concentration
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in recommended medium to obtain 1 × 10⁸ cells / mL (use 0.25–8 mL; if total cells <2.5 × 10⁷, resuspend in the minimum 0.25 mL).

steps.title: Transfer suspension to Falcon tube
steps.instruction: Move the cell suspension into a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add cocktails, mix, incubate
steps.instruction: Add the dead‑cell removal (Annexin V) cocktail and the Biotin Selection cocktail, then mix and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add Dead Cell Removal (Annexin V) cocktail – 50 µL per mL of suspension.
Add Biotin Selection cocktail – 50 µL per mL of suspension.

steps.title: Prepare and add RapidSpheres
steps.instruction: Vortex RapidSpheres™ and add them to the sample without further incubation.

substeps.instruction: Vortex RapidSpheres™ for 30 seconds until particles are evenly dispersed.
Add RapidSpheres™ – 100 µL per mL of suspension.
Mix gently; proceed immediately to the next step (no incubation).

steps.title: Top up medium and mix
steps.instruction: Adjust the total volume with recommended medium and mix gently.

substeps.instruction: Top up to 5 mL if the original sample volume is ≤2 mL; top up to 10 mL if >2 mL.
Mix gently by pipetting up‑and‑down 2–3 times.

steps.title: Incubate tube in magnet
steps.instruction: Place the tube (lid removed) into the magnetic separator and incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer enriched cell suspension
steps.instruction: Remove the magnet and invert the tube and magnet together to pour the enriched suspension into a new tube, then return upright.

substeps.instruction: Pick up the magnet and, in one continuous motion, invert the magnet and tube to pour the enriched cell suspension into a fresh tube.
Leave the tube and magnet inverted for 2–3 seconds, then return upright; do not shake or blot off any hanging drops.

steps.title: Count cells and viability
steps.instruction: Count cells and assess viability using a 1:1 trypan blue dilution.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL PBS containing 0.04 % BSA (200 µL) to the cells for washing.

steps.title: Centrifuge washed cells
steps.instruction: Spin the washed cells at 500 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend for Chromium loading
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate volume of 0.04 % BSA in PBS for loading onto the Chromium system.
